article.title: Your Googlebook won’t lose some of its best AI features even after your free AI Pro plan ends
article.summary: TL;DR Magic Pointer and Rambler won’t require a Google AI Pro subscription on Googlebooks. The new laptops include free 12 months of AI Pro, but the built-in features are separate from that perk. That means those headline AI features should keep working after the free year ends. Google is putting AI front and center with its first wave of Googlebooks , from Magic Pointer, which turns the humble cursor into a Gemini tool, to Rambler, which cleans up your rambling voice notes. There’s just one potential catch: every Googlebook also comes with a free year of Google AI Pro, which raises an obvious question about what happens to those headline AI features once the freebie runs out. article.title: Anthropic向Akamai採購116億美元CPU算力，取得最高5%認股權
article.summary: 雲端服務暨資安業者Akamai周四（9/24）宣布，擴大與Anthropic的合作，後者將在未來7年採購總值116億美元的雲端運算服務，以滿足持續成長的CPU工作負載需求。雙方合作規模未來還可能增加至約200億美元，Anthropic並取得認購Akamai最高約5%股權的權利。

article.title: Googlebook laptops are already selling out just days after pre-orders opened
article.summary: TL;DR Google’s US online store has already sold out of its available Googlebook pre-order stock just days after orders opened. Acer, Dell, and Lenovo Googlebooks are all unavailable there, suggesting stronger-than-expected demand or limited initial inventory. Best Buy still has Googlebooks available to pre-order ahead of their October 4 release. Google gave US shoppers barely enough time to decide whether its shiny new Googlebooks deserved a spot in their backpacks before making that decision a little harder. Pre-orders only opened on September 21 , but just a few days later, Google’s own online store appears to have burned through its available inventory. article.title: Docker Cloud Sandboxes上線，AI代理環境可在本機與雲端雙向搬移
article.summary: Docker推出Cloud Sandboxes雲端沙箱服務，將原本在開發者電腦執行的Docker Sandboxes隔離環境延伸到Docker管理的雲端運算資源。開發者可讓AI程式開發代理在雲端執行大型程式修改、測試等工作，並使用sbx move指令，在本機與雲端之間搬移沙箱環境。

article.title: AWS CloudWatch Omni納入AI代理品質測試，可比較模型與提示詞表現
article.summary: AWS擴充Amazon CloudWatch可觀測性服務，推出CloudWatch Omni，將AI代理與應用程式監控整合到同一環境。除了記錄延遲、詞元（Token）用量與工具呼叫等執行情況，CloudWatch Omni還能評估代理回答品質，並比較不同提示詞、模型與代理設定的結果，協助開發團隊找出版本變更後的品質退化問題。

article.title: Google推出Gemini Live Avatar，讓AI代理人有臉、有表情，還能即時對話
article.summary: Google周四（9/24）宣布推出Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar，為對話式AI加入即時生成的虛擬人物形象，讓AI代理人不只能聽、能說，還能透過臉部表情及嘴型與使用者互動，並在對話過程中呼叫工具執行任務，目前已於Gemini Enterprise中提供。
